scope: Validation-only ablations A6-A9 of FEEDBACK_PLAN_20261110 section 1-3. No test/holdout outcomes are loaded or scored.

fixed.protocol: protocols/common/neural-v1.json (epochs 15, batch 32, Adam, StepLR gamma 0.9/epoch, grad-norm clip 1, bf16 autocast, 1536-gene train panel with targets forced in, validation macro delta RMSE each epoch on 34 val interventions x 32 fixed eval controls)

lora_scale_rule: alpha = 2 x rank, so the LoRA scale alpha/rank stays 2 as in the registered M3 (rank 8, alpha 16)

runs.change: M3 LoRA r8 on QKV -> QKV + FFN linear1/linear2
single fixed control cell input -> mean of the full train control pool (7,353 cells) for every treated cell
natural exposure -> capped balanced downsampling: per epoch two fresh non-duplicating capped passes (each cell at most 2x/epoch)

data_modes.D0: Fixed control pairs; all 56,049 train cells once per epoch in a seeded shuffle (inherited, unchanged).
data_modes.Dmean: Same rows, order, panel and targets as D0. The control input of every treated cell is the dense mean of all 7,353 train-pool control cells (restricted to the batch gene panel). Validation is unchanged (per-eval-control predictions averaged); a diagnostic also scores the model when fed the mean of the 32 eval controls.
data_modes.Dcap: Per epoch exactly 56,049 examples (1,752 updates). Cap c = largest integer with 2*sum_i min(n_i, c) <= 56,049; intervention i receives e_i = 2*min(n_i, c) examples, and the remainder (< 2 x #capped) is spread round-robin (seeded order) over capped interventions. Rows of i are drawn by cycling a fresh per-epoch permutation of its cells, so the epoch equals two consecutive non-duplicating capped passes; each cell is used at most twice per epoch and capped interventions (n_i >= c+1) never repeat a cell when e_i <= n_i. Original fixed control pairs; global shuffle with the D0/D2 rng stream.
